answer_1.quote: The output y is the role record, presenting by the concatenation of each argument and its event role, i.e., <s> arg 1 role 1 ... arg n role n </s>.
answer_1.outputs: sequences of argument and role tokens in the format <s> arg1 role1 ... argn rolen </s>

answer_2.quote: Our results are reported as F-1 score of argument identification (Arg-I) and argument classification (Arg-C). For WikiEvents dataset, we follow to additionally evaluate argument head F1 score (Head-C).
